what: Waterfall relies on launcher process rc, but current launchers emit LAUNCHER_EXIT then exit 0
scenario_or_breakage: A failed Cursor/Codex agent is treated as tier success, so Codex/Claude never run and post-success commit/push logic executes after a failed fix
suggested_fix: Make #2395 or this plan change launcher exit semantics to exit with LAUNCHER_EXIT, or have run_ci_fix_vendor parse LAUNCHER_EXIT from stdout before deciding tier success; add a regression where the launcher exits 0 but emits LAUNCHER_EXIT=1

what: Plan forwards raw gh-run-logs output as --failure-log to external agents
scenario_or_breakage: CI logs can contain secrets, internal URLs, PII, or private hostnames; append-tool-failure redaction does not protect this prompt-injection path because the raw capture is handed to Cursor/Codex/Claude
suggested_fix: Materialize a redacted failure-log file with redact-tmpdir-paths.sh and redact-secrets.sh before launcher injection, fail closed or omit on redaction failure, add token-redaction tests, and update SECURITY.md for the new CI-log prompt surface

what: Path-list rollback cannot restore pre-tier dirty tracked content exactly
scenario_or_breakage: If a failed tier modifies a file that was already dirty at function entry, either the next tier sees contaminated edits or rollback discards operator work back to HEAD
suggested_fix: Run each tier in a disposable worktree/branch and apply only the successful tier patch, or snapshot and restore exact index/worktree state with patch/stash mechanics rather than name-only deltas

what: All tiers share one output/token sidecar path
scenario_or_breakage: Failed Cursor can leave ci-fix output.token-record; a later successful Codex/Claude tier that does not write a token record can cause stale token accounting or stale prompt/meta artifacts to be appended
suggested_fix: Use a per-tier output basename, or remove output sidecars before each tier and append only the winning tier's token record

what: Plan allows a new fix-loop-3tier section but does not require wiring it into section dispatch targets
scenario_or_breakage: A new section can pass in ad hoc runs but be skipped by make test-ship-pr-fix-loop and harness shards, leaving the intended regressions out of make lint
suggested_fix: Prefer extending the existing fix-loop section; if a new section is created, add the Makefile target, shard dependency, docs/linting.md entry, and section comment updates in the same change
